question: Should memory-lancedb permanently expose all three recall controls, including the internal candidate-overfetch value, with the proposed bounds?
rationale: Repository policy sets a high bar for new configuration, and code review cannot decide whether overfetch is a supported operator contract or an internal sludge-filtering invariant.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Expose the user-meaningful score and result cap, derive a safe overfetch internally, and require full-path live-hook proof before merge.

options.title: Approve all three settings
options.body: Accept the proposed plugin configuration and bounds after an owner confirms the operational contract and the contributor supplies full-path proof.

options.title: Keep fixed policy
options.body: Retain the existing hardcoded recall policy and close or rework this proposal if permanent tuning surface is not wanted.

recommendation.title: Narrow the contract
recommendation.body: Expose the user-meaningful score and result cap, derive a safe overfetch internally, and require full-path live-hook proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged configurable capture-limit and recall-hardening work is the closest historical ownership signal for this decision.
